All sales utilized are all similar to the subject in most major units of comparison; age, location, design, GLA, view, and utility. Sale activity from within the subject's market area is the best indicator of value as sales prices of comparable properties from the same location should reflect the same positive and negative location characteristics.

Sale #1 was utilized due to being a recent comparable sale from the subject's market area. This sale warranted a market conditions adjustment due to having been sold over three months ago. Sale #1 warranted a condition (C3) adjustment due to this sale having superior updated features compared to the subject that has only limited updates. This sale warranted a GLA adjustment due to being larger in living area sq. ft. compared to the subject property. Sale #1 warranted a garage adjustment as it features a one car garage and the subject does not have any covered parking. This sale was selected to bracket the subject's living area sq. ft. and a lack of more recent comparable sales within the subject's market area.

Sale #2 was utilized due to being a recent comparable sale from the subject's market area. This sale did not warrant a market conditions adjustment due to having been sold within the past three months. Sale #2 warranted a concessions adjustment as the seller credited the buyer with closing costs. Sale #2 warranted a condition (C3) adjustment due to this sale having superior updated features compared to the subject that has only limited updates. This sale warranted a GLA adjustment due to being smaller in living area sq. ft. compared to the subject property. Sale #2 is located slightly over 1 mile from the subject. This has no adverse effect of the subject's current estimate of market value given as this sale is from within the subject's market area. This is due to the subject's market area extending several miles and the subject is located in the southern edge of said market area. Sale #2 was mostly selected due to being one of the most recent comparable sales from the subject's market area.

Sale #3 was utilized due to being a recent comparable sale from the subject's market area. This sale warranted a market conditions adjustment due to having been sold over three months ago. Sale #3 warranted a concessions adjustment as the seller credited the buyer with closing costs. This sale warranted a condition (C3) adjustment due to this sale having superior updated features compared to the subject that has only limited updates. Sale #3 warranted a GLA adjustment due to being smaller in living area sq. ft. compared to the subject property. This sale was also selected due to its close proximity to the subject and similar lot size.

Sale #4 was utilized due to being a recent comparable sale from the subject's market area. This sale warranted a market conditions adjustment due to having been sold over three months ago. Sale #4 warranted a bathroom adjustment as it features one  full bathroom and the subject has two full bathrooms. Sale #4 warranted a GLA adjustment due to being smaller in living area sq. ft. compared to the subject property. This sale was selected despite being inferior to the subject in bedroom and bathroom counts, due to a lack of more recent comparable sales from the subject's market area.

Comparable #5 is a listing from the subject's market area. This listing was included per lender's request for a listing from the subject's market area. This comparable was also utilized as a good indicator of current market trends in the subject's market area.

While site sizes vary a market extraction data could be found that would show a market contribution to the differences that exist.  Site adjustments have been made on the grid at $1.00/sq.ft. of difference  No adjustments for bedroom count could be extracted from the market place and if any were deemed necessary it would have been reflected in the overall GLA.  No market extraction could be determined for the variances in style of the subject and comparable and therefore no adjustment was deemed necessary as this is considered an individual buyers preference, with no consideration towards the subjects value or market ability.  No market extraction could be determined for the variances in age of the subject and comparable and therefore no adjustment was deemed necessary.  A market based adjustment was made for variances in basement finish at $10.00 per sf for a finished and/or part finished basement.  The major artery dividing some comparables from the subject property does not pose any sort of market division or barrier in the region.  GLA Adjustment: $60.00/sf Garage Door Adjustment: $4,000 Attached Garage Adjustment: $4,000 Fireplace Adjustment:  $2,000  All adjustments, including kitchen are baths are market driven adjustments based on matched paired analysis. Adjustments were based on photos and data contained within the mls listings sheets, discussions with the listing and or selling brokers.  GLA is adjusted at $60.00 per SF, no adjustments for less than 100 sf and reflects the marginal contribution of the difference in Gross Living Area rather than average cost. The adjustment was a market derived adjustment developed through sales analysis of similar style and square foot homes based on the contributory value of the GLA (20%) adjusted sales price is determined by sales pr
- **Why / reviewer line:** Narrative discusses comparables but does not clearly bracket the value between unadjusted and adjusted prices; please verify.
